status: Local source repair validated; publication pending
finding: Setup checked root instructions and adapter conflicts before bootstrap but checked an existing incompatible atm.mjs only after bootstrap had created governance files. Dry-run omitted the launcher check entirely. This left a partially configured project after a predictable failure. A write-boundary review also found that a shared npm launcher arriving after an absence check could be adopted without comparing its bytes.
expectedBehavior: Plan the project launcher without writing before both real and dry-run setup. Reuse canonical pinned-runner source selection and npm identity/integrity checks, preserve every existing byte on conflict, and carry the same observed absence into exclusive creation at the write boundary. Existing explicit force behavior for the lower-level bootstrap remains unchanged.
evidenceOrRepro: tests/cli/setup-install.test.ts reproduced actual setup residue, false-positive dry-run, and concurrent pinned-file overwrite before repair. The corrected tests cover full path/digest preservation, directory/symlink/non-UTF-8 conflicts, valid pinned setup/rerun, new data and legacy layout npm integrity checks, npm planning with no bootstrap, and exclusive creation for pinned and npm launchers. Independent review identified the npm arrival seam; both npm layout cases then failed red and passed green with a retained preflight snapshot and no bootstrap marker.
followUp: Rebuild and run frozen and installed acceptance before claiming distribution availability. The preflight is an optimistic admission check; runtime writes must retain their exclusive creation and fresh validation protections.
